text:
ops-incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API p99 latency > 8s for last 5m, request_queue length 22k, GPU pool saturating in us-east-1. Auto-scale attempts failing (quota/limit). Paging oncall. :rotating_light:
carla: seeing the same on dashboards — thousands of queued requests, error spikes from timeouts. Most traffic from /v1/generate (marketing campaign).
ben: oncall here, joining. quick checks: autoscaler logs?
carla: pasted logs ->
```
2026-03-17T01:12:34Z autoscaler ERROR: provisioner create failed: quotaExceeded: Insufficient GPUs for request (req=20, available=12)
2026-03-17T01:12:40Z provisioner WARN: backoff retry 3/5
2026-03-17T01:13:02Z routed-request INFO: fallback routing enabled -> cpu-quantized-p3 (degraded performance)
```
alex: provisioning API shows many pending instances in cloud console, stuck in provisioning state for ~6m. Quota is the blocker.
miguel: confirmed quota = account-level GPU quota, us-east-1. Cloud support queue slow right now. We can patch by re-routing some non-critical tenants to eu-central or enable fallback models.
ben: mitigation plan, short list: 1) enable emergency per-route throttles (limit /v1/generate to 30 rps for anon traffic) 2) enable degraded model fallback globally for bursty routes 3) open temporary routing to eu region for selected customers 4) notify SRE to request quota bump with cloud ops. Implementing 1 and 2 now.
carla: I pushed rate limit config to edge: `traffic-control:set --route /v1/generate --limit 30 --window 1s --scope anon` -> confirmed applied. :white_check_mark:
ben: enabling degraded-fallback policy: `redwoodctl config set fallback.degraded=true --scope hosted` -> applied. This will send new requests to q4-small models (lower throughput but keeps tail down).
miguel: started region re-route for 4 tenants to eu-central as stopgap. Notifying sales-cs for impacted customers.
sales-cs: FYI i notified two paying customers on the campaign, added temporary credits and offered rate-limited endpoints. They want ETA.
ben: ETA for full resolution depends on cloud quota bump; filed support ticket #CLOUD-23871 and escalated. Manual scale won't pass until quota increases.
carla: monitoring update: p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 1.1s after rate-limit + fallback. p99 still ~3.6s, queue down from 22k -> 9k in 12 minutes. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/hosted/queue?snapshot=8349997777
alex: note: some older internal jobs still hit hosted pool, I've paused non-critical background jobs to free slots.
ben: rolling incident channel created (#inc-8349997777). Pager duty notified. I'll keep watch and update every 10m.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by ben. On-call rotation: ben -> alice in 45m.
miguel: cloud support responded: provisional quota increase estimated 28-60 minutes if approved. They're requesting justification (escalating).
carla: action items: - keep rate limits for 30m - continue degraded fallback for 1h - follow up with cloud support - postmortem owner assigned: carla.
ben: temporary customer impact note: some requests may get 503 for heavy payloads; we've prioritized customers with active payments and rerouted them. Please escalate any blocked customers to sales-cs.
sales-cs: one customer reported timeouts for 20% of requests; we applied region reroute, monitoring their success.
ops-incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: queue length 9k, p99 3.4s, degraded fallback handling ~42% of traffic, rate limits rejecting ~12% of requests. Continue mitigation.
carla: logging the incident ticket and initial timeline. Will draft a short external blurb for support.
ben: leaving handoff note for next oncall (alice): current mitigations in place, cloud ticket open, ETA ~45m-60m for quota. If quota not granted, escalate to infra lead to consider emergency temporary capacity purchase.
op-incident-bot: END-OF-THREAD NOTE: This thread will be updated with final resolution and postmortem link. Follow-ups: postmortem, autoscaler improvement (better preflight quota checks), per-campaign pre-warming runbook. :clipboard:
